:::{#lem-wilks-lrt-quadratic}
#### Likelihood ratio statistic for a point null hypothesis

Under the conditions of @lem-wilks-taylor,
for the point null hypothesis $H_0: \param = \param_0$,
which imposes $q = 1$ constraint,
the [likelihood ratio statistic](#def-lrt-stat) is approximately
the [observed information](#def-oinf) times the squared distance from the MLE:

$$\lrstat \approx \oinf(\hthml)(\hthml - \param_0)^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-wilks-lrt-quadratic.
It rests on @lem-wilks-taylor.

:::
